title: Great Barrier Reef enquiry task and marking grid
subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y4 lesson 19 (Great Barrier Reef enquiry task and marking grid (portal printable; assessed))
intro: Lesson 19: Enquiry: how are people affecting the Great Barrier Reef?. To understand how to answer a geographical enquiry using evidence and a reasoned judgement

questions.q: Give one piece of evidence that people harm the reef.
questions.a: For example: farm chemicals wash into the sea
questions.model: Evidence is a fact. Farm chemicals wash off fields into rivers and the sea. That is a fact about harm.

questions.q: Give one way people help the reef.
questions.a: No-fishing zones, cleaner farming, mooring buoys

questions.q: Write your enquiry answer in the portal response box (2 paragraphs). Start: 'People are affecting the Great Barrier Reef by...' then 'I recommend... because...'
questions.a: Two paragraphs: at least two pieces of evidence, effects explained, a justified recommendation
questions.model: Teacher shows the paragraph 1 model again and the first line of paragraph 2.

questions.q: Add a sentence on who should act: Australia, other countries or both.
questions.a: Both, because warming seas are global

questions.q: Add a 'however' sentence showing another point of view.
questions.a: For example: however, tourism brings money that pays for protection

questions.q: Big question: how are people affecting the reef, and what should be done?
questions.a: Harm through warming, pollution and careless use; protect with marine park rules, cleaner farming and less pollution
